tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (Cerberus surface-50 / surface-950).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `field` and `wash`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, meta lines and input borders on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tabs and nav items, selected day, chat launcher, focus ring. Not for text on `bg` (use `link`).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: "Open or needs attention" only: seats left, open seats, pending requests, badges with counts.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, drawer, tab bar.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside inputs, selects and textareas.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill. Cerberus' own pair is 3.6:1, which is why layout.css makes it white.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a `warning` fill (count badges, `preset-filled-warning-500`).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: text, error borders, "Suspenso".

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons and error counts (`preset-filled-error-700`), with white text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders (decorative, not control borders).

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover, selected row, segmented-control track, dropzone background.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Background of attention banners and open-seat dots.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links on `bg` and `surface`: primary-600 in light, primary-300 in dark.

tokens.name: seat-1
tokens.usage: First taken seat; success dot (Ativo/Ativa); ok toast disc. Mark only, never text.

tokens.name: seat-2
tokens.usage: Second taken seat. Mark only.

tokens.name: seat-3
tokens.usage: Third taken seat. Mark only.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Desktop page titles (h1, `md:text-7xl`). (`text-7xl leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight`)
styles.sample: Tem uma cadeira vazia na mesa.

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: Smaller desktop page titles (h1, `md:text-6xl`). (`text-6xl leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight`)

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Smaller page titles; phone hero. (`text-5xl leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight`)

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Phone page titles (h1); big section titles. (`text-4xl leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight`)

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Section titles; titles that may wrap. (`text-3xl leading-tight font-semibold tracking-tight`)

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Escolha uma mesa, veja quantas vagas restam e quando é a próxima sessão.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Entre na hora ou peça a vaga, conforme a mesa.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, breadcrumbs, meta lines. (`text-sm font-semibold`)

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The "Mesa Aberta" wordmark next to the mark. Nowhere else. (`text-lg font-semibold tracking-wide`)

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in chips. (`gap-1`)

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows, between chips. (`gap-2`)

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons; card inner gaps. (`gap-3`)

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter of fixed UI; field stacks. (`p-4`)

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter. (`px-5`)

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gaps. (`gap-6`)

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Form section padding (desktop). (`p-8`)

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page columns; space above page titles. (`gap-12`)

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything tappable (small buttons). (`h-11`)

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Bubble tails, tiny marks. (`rounded-xs`)

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, cards, menus, panels. (`rounded-lg`)

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, badges, segmented controls, avatars, seats, the chat launcher. (`rounded-full`)

tokens.name: w-nav-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed desktop nav column. (`w-20`)

tokens.name: w-menu
tokens.usage: Kebab and account menus. (`w-66`)

tokens.name: w-aside
tokens.usage: Sticky side panel on table/form pages; toasts; the messages drawer. (`w-96`)

tokens.name: w-side
tokens.usage: Form and profile column width. (`max-w-xl`)

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of the keyboard focus outline: solid `primary`, 2px offset. (`outline-4`)

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, the messages drawer. (`shadow-2xl`)

tokens.name: shadow-launcher
tokens.usage: Chat launcher only. (`shadow-lg`)
